doc.description:
Retrieve live telemetry data from a KISS or KISS compatible ESCs. If using an opensource ESC like AM32 or ESCape Do make sure to enable the KISS telemetry output in the settings of the ESC.
+ If KISS_TELEMETRY_MOTOR_POLES is set incorrectly the RPM value will be incorrect. + Make sure to connect the ESC telemetry output wire to the correct UART RX pin on your flightcontroller.

configure.name: KISS_TELEMETRY_PORT
configure.description: Set the UART port the ESC telemetry output wire is connected to on your flightcontroller, defaults to UART1

configure.name: KISS_TELEMETRY_MOTOR_POLES
configure.description: Number of poles you have on your motor, is always an even number, default is 14
